problem: Production readback after the runtime repair still exposed a stale mobile V18 Platform anchor to /bedrijfsgeheugen in final generated HTML.
root_cause: The pinned V18 payload contains a historical mobile Platform href and is projected late in the build. A runtime-only repair did not make the generated artifact itself canonical.
decision: Make the final navigation contract the last authority: normalize every visible Platform anchor to https://www.bedrijfsgeheugen.nl/product and fail verification if any final shell differs.
prevention: Final generated desktop and mobile Platform anchors always resolve to /product.
Pinned or legacy shell payloads cannot reintroduce /bedrijfsgeheugen for the Platform label after finalization.
The final navigation regression test contains the historical mobile drift and requires both Platform anchors to resolve to /product.

historical_replay: The pinned V18 mobile drawer contained Platform -> /bedrijfsgeheugen while the desktop route resolved to /product.
The final navigation contract now rewrites the stale mobile href before publication and verifies all Platform anchors.
regression_contract: Every visible Platform anchor in final shell HTML resolves to https://www.bedrijfsgeheugen.nl/product
Final verification fails closed on any Platform destination drift
